Status
: [In development]{.proto-status .s-dev}

What it is
: A search tool for finding BigPicture datasets that match what you need, by their metadata. From the results you request access in [REMS](rems.qmd). For now it covers clinical datasets only. Later it will support Dataset on Demand: picking images from several datasets and requesting them as one.

Who it's for
: Researchers looking for data.

Provided by
: CSC

Before you start
: An [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd) login, with membership of your organisation's [Perun](perun.qmd) group.

How to get access
: Sign in at [discovery.bigpicture.eu](https://discovery.bigpicture.eu).

Guides
: [None yet]{.proto-none}

Terms and privacy
: [BigPicture privacy notice](https://bigpicture.eu/bigpicture-privacy-notice)

Support
: ::: {.proto-support provider="CSC" owner="[Name], CSC" second="[Name], CSC" hours="weekdays 08:00–16:00, best effort; answer within 3 working days"}
  :::

Related services
: [REMS](rems.qmd), [Landing pages](landing-pages.qmd) (public, no login), [Repository](repository.qmd), [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd), [Perun](perun.qmd)

Source code

## Before you start

You need an [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd) login and membership of your organisation's [Perun](perun.qmd) group.

## How to get access

Sign in at [discovery.bigpicture.eu](https://discovery.bigpicture.eu). Found a dataset you want? Apply for it in [REMS](rems.qmd).

To look at datasets without logging in, use the [Landing pages](landing-pages.qmd).

Search BigPicture's datasets by what's in them, such as organ, stain or diagnosis, and find the ones that fit your research.

::: {.proto-tasks}
::: {}
#### Search
[Sign in to Discovery](https://discovery.bigpicture.eu) with your LS AAI login.
:::

::: {}
#### Request access
Apply for the datasets you found in [REMS](rems.qmd).
:::

::: {}
#### Just browsing?
The [Landing pages](landing-pages.qmd) need no login.
:::
:::

Discovery is still in development and only covers clinical datasets for now. Coming later: **Dataset on Demand**, where you pick images from several datasets and request them as one.
